name: qkd_land_seg-sg1-COMMIT
purpose: KV/system die landing strip SEGMENT qkd_land_seg (VIS-ROM D-QK-02): one row-engine group = 4 CLOSED qkd_land_pc (E column, 378-um HBM PC pitch) + the CLOSED qkd_land_grp_epoch (W column), wires only, 5 child clock entries; ONE master replicated 32x on the die (g / st straps). Cycle-identical to qkd_land_strip_s (yosys equivalence).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_land_seg u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/qkd_land_seg.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_land_seg/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_land_seg/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_land_seg --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_land_seg --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_land_grp_epoch/views/qkd_land_grp_epoch --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_land_pc/views/qkd_land_pc > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: new master (D-QK-02): replaces the never-hardened 172.8 x 12,141 landing strip frame by 8 identical 1,512-um segments of closed leaves
